title: items
summary: ItemTemplateCache is ask-once with in-flight dedupe and cached negatives, and the full 5875 query body now retains tooltip/use fields including page text, lock id, reputation requirements, and authored durability. Right-click open/unwrap matches the reference predicates, ordering, tooltip promise, and pending lock. All seven owned enchant slots plus inspected public slots resolve through SpellItemEnchantment with hidden-name/sign/color/charges laws and server-driven temporary-enchant countdowns. SMSG_SET_PROFICIENCY is session-scoped; inventory hover renders the classic content order and independent hard-miss, alternate-subclass, and Dual Wield slot/type colors, while vendor usability applies the own-subclass gate.

openItems.text: SMSG_ITEM_ENCHANT_TIME_UPDATE is not handled (no opcode case anywhere): temporary-enchant countdown deadlines are never tracked, so no tooltip timer can exist
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: strict 24-byte parsing and live dispatch maintain absolute deadlines keyed by item guid and enchant slot; zero seconds removes the timer and session reset clears all deadlines.

openItems.text: Item tooltips print no enchant lines: SpellItemEnchantment names (abs(id) row, sign->color, Flags&0x2 hide gate, charges/countdown) never reach any tooltip surface - EnchantCatalog is only consumed by the enchant-confirm gate
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: bag, paper-doll, shopping-comparison and inspect tooltips resolve abs(id), suppress Flags&0x2, apply slot-specific signed colors, append charges, and use Benilla's day/hour/minute ceil plus seconds-truncate countdown law.

openItems.text: Right-click open/unwrap is absent: no CMSG_OPEN_ITEM path and no LOOTABLE/lock-gate/WRAPPER predicates, so clams, lockboxes and wrapped gifts cannot be opened from the bags (ItemTemplate.Parse even discards the lock id field)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: item templates retain PageText/LockId; the inventory law owns LOOTABLE, WRAPPER, UNLOCKED and WRAPPED predicates; right-click sends exact CMSG_OPEN_ITEM for gifts and lootables, grays lootables pending response, and shows the gated green affordance.

openItems.text: SMSG_SET_PROFICIENCY did not update a session proficiency map, so weapon/armor type permissions could not affect inventory hover or vendor usability.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: strict u8+u32 parsing feeds a session-scoped class mask; ItemSubClass alternate/display flags and first-lane Dual Wield effect reproduce the tooltip's independent slot/type red cells, and the basic vendor gate checks the item's own subclass bit.
